en.plugins.qr.desc: Generate a QR code from a text, a link, a Wi-Fi or a contact card
en.plugins.qr.usage:
{0}qr <text or link>
Or reply to a message with {0}qr.

Examples:
• {0}qr https://example.com
• {0}qr WIFI:T:WPA;S:MyNetwork;P:MyPassword;;

Line breaks are kept, so contact cards (vCard) work too. Maximum {1} characters.
